title: The Hollow One
description: A surreal ballpoint pen illustration exploring curiosity, transformation and the unknown. The butterfly becomes a fragile contrast against a figure emerging from darkness, suggesting both decay and rebirth.
quote: Fear rarely arrives screaming. It grows quietly in the dark.

title: Metamorphosis
description: A psychological portrait depicting inner conflict, transformation and emotional decay. The distorted anatomy represents the struggle between identity and self perception.
quote: We become strangers long before we change.

title: The Observer
description: An unsettling study of perception and silent presence. The single eye exists between darkness and awareness, suggesting a watcher hidden beyond ordinary sight.

title: Smile Without Eyes
description: A portrait suspended between familiarity and dread. The expression remains frozen in an impossible smile, while the absence of eyes removes every trace of human comfort and emotion.

title: Unhinged
description: A study of emotional collapse and distorted anatomy. The figure appears trapped between transformation and destruction, creating tension through impossible forms and exaggerated expression.
quote: The fracture began long before it was visible.

title: The Hand That Sees
description: A surreal fusion of touch and perception. The eye emerges from the hand as a symbol of awareness, suggesting that understanding can come through instinct, memory and sensation rather than sight alone.
quote: Some truths are felt before they are seen.

title: The Clown Below
description: A distorted clown figure emerging from darkness, balancing absurdity and dread. The exaggerated features transform a familiar symbol of entertainment into something unsettling and psychologically ambiguous.
quote: The mask smiles long after the laughter ends.

title: Sewn Flesh
description: Fragments stitched together in an attempt to become whole. The piece explores trauma, repair and identity, where every scar becomes evidence of survival rather than a mark of weakness.
quote: What was broken never truly disappeared.

title: Watcher
description: A silent presence emerging from darkness. The elongated form and hollow gaze create a feeling of being observed from somewhere beyond the visible world.
quote: When nobody is watching, something always is.

title: Without Eyes
description: A faceless figure emerging from absolute darkness. The absence of eyes removes every anchor of human connection, leaving only an oppressive sense of being watched by something that sees without being seen.
quote: When nobody is watching, something always is.
